purpose: Machine-readable map from each commissioned correction to the section that answers it, with the change and the reason. Proposal only; closes nothing.

corrections.previousDefect: Sender identity was said to come from the Lambda invocation context's caller role; a shared handler cannot observe its caller, and a role ARN cannot populate the 64-character profile-alphabet sender field.
corrections.change: One admission function per delivering principal, each with its own handler and execution role, and a registry mapping function name → short sender id → role/permitted mode/key ids. Five options evaluated; per-function structure chosen; broker, shared-function-plus-deny, private-network-only and caller-signed-delivery rejected with reasons.
corrections.status: OPEN — design answered; no closure claimed

corrections.previousDefect: A resource-policy allow list was treated as a deny for other same-account principals, and SDK invocation was called private although no network restriction exists.
corrections.change: Seven stacked controls: narrow identity grant conditioned on lambda:SourceFunctionArn; explicit resource-policy Deny to Principal '*' with ArnNotEquals aws:PrincipalArn and StringNotEquals aws:PrincipalAccount; structural per-sender functions; role-trust conditions; permissions boundary plus SCP caveat; invoke-capable principal inventory; reserved concurrency. Qualified-ARN/alias rules added. 'No public HTTP route' explicitly separated from 'no externally possible SDK invoke'.
keyFacts: Identity and resource allows combine by union; an explicit deny overrides (IAM evaluation-logic page)
lambda:SourceFunctionArn is usable in identity policies/SCPs, not resource policies, and does not support versions or aliases (Lambda doc)
aws:SourceAccount is available only for AWS-service-principal calls, so it cannot serve as direct-invoke provenance
corrections.status: OPEN — design answered; policy evaluation and inventory not executed

corrections.previousDefect: Rev2 replaced a concrete ≥24 h rotation overlap with 'an overlap window', while carried files still required 24 h; key classes were conflated.
corrections.change: Numeric minima per class: assertion keys ≥24 h (two-client replacement if dual-key is unsupported); issuer signing keys ≥24 h, 48 h recommended (2 h Gateway cache + 900 s token + skew, with margin); TLS truststore ≥24 h and renew with ≥30 days left; C4 evidence keys ≥7 days verify-window with a 24 h floor only if Requirements confirms a shorter late horizon. Precedence statement added.
corrections.status: OPEN — restored control; no rotation exercised

corrections.previousDefect: Analytical claims contradicted source or pinned text: cold-start registry cache, ACL_AUTH as evidence signer, five fixture-sized payload maxima, unreachable diagnostic path, cursor/lease equality, incomplete contract overlay.
corrections.change: Each corrected explicitly; ACL_AUTH reduced to transport identity; registry read corrected to per-request strongly consistent; payload rows withdrawn in favour of the exact 6 964 guard plus achievable 5 684/5 940; diagnostic forwarding routed only through verifyForwarded; cursor equality withdrawn; O5 lease and retention-cursor staleness added to the CA-5 gap list.
corrections.status: OPEN — corrections made here; other owners' documents unchanged

corrections.previousDefect: The relay key was described as having no payment authority, although console.write can initiate an authorized synthetic payment.
corrections.change: Can/cannot table: payment initiation yes (through mTLS + demo token + mandate and within idempotency/claim/no-resend), C4 signing no, direct issuer decision no. Credential treated as payment-initiation severity with narrow scopes and per-demo rotation.

corrections.previousDefect: Mid-pass cursor re-mint and resynchronization were required but undefined; reconnect/issuance load was unbounded, turning a 900 s lease into a DoS surface.
corrections.change: Corrected cursor/lease facts; page-boundary stop rule; two compliant continuations (default new-snapshot restart, optional contract-delta same-snapshot continuation) with explicit 410 and no-silent-extension rules; reconnect jitter, single-flight token acquisition, issuer backoff, connection/frame rate limits, reserved concurrency, cohort jitter, accounting. No change to the owner-accepted no-mTLS decision.
corrections.status: OPEN — obligations defined; nothing implemented or measured
